name: Obydennaja procedura
source:
The bailiff, Ivan, breaks the procedure for the first time. His son's life depends on the decision whether the criminal will be executed or pardoned posthumously by becoming an organ donor.

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/33-1-0-2618]Anivisual[/url]]
